description: This file contains utility functions for reading and parsing configuration files related to anchor parameters and pyramid levels in a RetinaNet object detection setup. It includes functions to read a config file, parse anchor parameters, and parse pyramid levels, utilizing external libraries such as configparser, numpy, and tensorflow.keras.

methods.name: read_config_file
methods.description: Reads and validates a configuration file, ensuring it contains necessary sections and keys.

methods.name: parse_anchor_parameters
methods.description: Parses anchor parameters such as ratios, scales, sizes, and strides from the config.

methods.name: parse_pyramid_levels
methods.description: Extracts pyramid level information from the configuration.
